title: Correctness-Guaranteed Symbolic Periodic-Distinguisher Model
summary: Current symbolic construction needs a separate correctness test as initial x symbols increase; the open task is a model that guarantees correct periodic distinguishers directly.

formal_statement.body: Develop a more precise symbolic model for automated periodic-distinguisher construction when the number of initial symbols denoted $x$ increases. The current symbolic model requires an additional testing phase to ensure the correctness of an output distinguisher; the new model must guarantee correctness directly and eliminate that testing phase.

scope.domain: Automated symmetric cryptanalysis through symbolic construction of periodic distinguishers.
parameters: Number of initial symbols denoted x — the varying quantity under which a more precise model is sought
scope.unresolved_remainder: Develop a more precise symbolic model that guarantees correctness of its output periodic distinguishers without an additional testing phase as the number of initial x symbols increases.

citations.label: Quantum Periodic Distinguisher Construction: Symbolization Method and Automated Tool

progress.summary: The paper presents this as one of two open problems and a direction for future work. Its first symbolic model still requires separate correctness testing when the number of initial x symbols increases.
citation_labels: Qun Liu et al., Quantum Periodic Distinguisher Construction: Symbolization Method and Automated Tool
